quotes.text: don't usually do the Moz prefix in the class name

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For a new custom element whose tag has no moz- prefix, omit Moz from its class name. The lazy-findbar element uses LazyFindbar. Keep a prefix when an established element and class already use it.
title: Match custom element class prefixes to their tag names
